headline: South Australian Business Confidence Slumps Amid Rising Wage and Energy Costs
summary: Business confidence in South Australia declined as a survey showed nearly three-quarters of respondents cited wage, energy, and restriction costs as major factors squeezing operations.
why: Rising input costs and diminished business sentiment can constrain commercial investment and hiring activity within regional economies.

impacts.name: Australia
impacts.why: Slumping business confidence driven by high wage and energy costs pressures regional commercial activity.
